ford-starter-load-test.title: 1994 Ford 4.9L starter load test
ford-starter-load-test.reviewed: Loaded current is measured with the specified tester and compared with applicable electrical specifications. No current limits or performance values are inferred from CAD.

ford-starter-no-load-test.title: 1994 Ford 4.9L starter no-load bench test
ford-starter-no-load-test.reviewed: The page identifies winding faults and rubbing; excess current prompts checks for armature rubbing, shaft bending, bearing binding and shorts involving armature or brushes. Learning content does not reproduce a live high-current test procedure.

ford-starter-solenoid-test.title: 1994 Ford 4.9L starter solenoid test
ford-starter-solenoid-test.reviewed: Names S-to-M and S-to-frame continuity paths and contamination inspection. Current geometry lacks the distinct S terminal and complete internal electrical circuit; the lesson states that omission.
